scientific_role: prediction-first spatial mechanism probe that transfers a frozen affinity-decoder ranking signal into variable local shape by deterministic image-and-RAD-DINO geodesic propagation; not a pseudo-mask consumer
scientific_question: Can fixed high-confidence rank seeds from the image-label-only RAD-DINO affinity decoder be expanded along radiograph and frozen token structure without the anatomy-scale overexpansion caused by global support matching?

source_affinity_decoder.interpretation: continuous localization/ranking is credible but fixed support does not recover extent

rejected_raw_proposal_selector.interpretation: global support matching rewards whole anatomy-scale SAM masks; a local variable-area transfer is required

primary.paper: Fu et al., UM-CAM: Uncertainty-weighted Multi-resolution Class Activation Maps for Weakly-supervised Segmentation
primary.transferred_mechanism: foreground/background seeds, local geodesic distance, exponential cue fusion, and continuous ambiguity

explicit_non_reproduction: The official script imports segmentation GT before generation; this protocol separates generation and freezes all maps before any GT loader.

The official script searches a per-image CAM threshold and uses the largest component centroid/bounding-box corners; this protocol instead reuses the affinity decoder's already-frozen top-1-percent foreground and bottom-50-percent background rank mining.
FastGeodis is replaced by an exact deterministic 8-neighbour shortest-path graph so the implementation is source-controlled and independently auditable.
No journal validation-tuned segmentation loss weight, CAM threshold, lesion size, or BTXRD validation metric is transferred.

prediction_inputs_allowed: 371 frozen image-label-only affinity-decoder maps and their complete provenance package
deterministic grayscale intensity derived from each radiograph
prediction_inputs_forbidden: BTXRD polygons, masks, boxes, points, scribbles, lesion area, or subgroup identity
validation GT metrics or per-image oracle routing during map generation
weak_supervision_contract.validation_gt: may be imported only after the 371 output maps, manifest, generation metadata, and prediction_freeze.json are written and hash-bound

frozen_rad_dino.input: black square pad then bicubic resize to 448x448 with frozen RAD-DINO normalization

geodesic_refinement.graph_grid: 64x64 in the continuous unpadded image-content frame

structural_projection.method: seed-42 frozen Gaussian projection followed by per-token L2 normalization

geodesic_refinement.branch_normalization: divide each branch by its within-image median positive horizontal/vertical neighbour difference, then weight both branches by 1/sqrt(2)

edge_graph.cost: step_length multiplied by combined feature difference plus the numeric spatial floor 1/max(height,width)

seeds.foreground: exact top 1% rank of the frozen affinity map on the 64x64 content grid
seeds.background: exact bottom 50% rank of the same map
seeds.ambiguous: remaining 49% stays continuous and is not assigned a hard training label

fusion.formula: UM-CAM-inspired exponential foreground/background geodesic cue with ratio 1, confidence blend with the source affinity map, then content-only min-max normalization
fusion.output: bilinear 320x320 float16 map with deterministic radiograph background zeroed

geodesic_refinement.normal_images: exact all-zero output from the supplied image-level normal label

baseline.arm: frozen RAD-DINO affinity-decoder validation maps before geodesic refinement

continuous: image-level AUROC from raw foreground p99 over all 371 images
evaluation.comparison: geodesic-minus-source for every localization metric with paired complete-group bootstrap, 10000 replicates, seed family 20260727

relative_required.overall_dice_p90: geodesic-minus-source paired complete-group CI95 lower bound >0
relative_required.subgroups_dice_p90: mean delta >=0 separately for small, medium, and large

predeclared_gate.on_pass: authorize only the creation of a separate immutable train-map and partial-label/consistency consumer protocol; do not train automatically
predeclared_gate.on_fail: reject this fixed geodesic configuration without changing ranks, ratio, feature weights, graph cost, thresholds, or routing after GT

relation_to_operational_goal.interpretation: this probe cannot satisfy the consumer goal; it tests whether local representation-to-shape transfer is strong enough to justify a separately frozen consumer
